verdict: Lemlist: Choose lemlist when multichannel cold outreach is the job — treat it as SI landscape cold-email coverage, not a ranked contact-database pick. Scores use the sales-intelligence editorial methodology from first-party research — not hands-on product testing.
weaknesses: Not an SI data-core peer — landscape only
bestFor: Teams whose primary job is multichannel cold outreach (email + LinkedIn)
SMB outbound comparing lemlist vs Instantly/Smartlead
Buyers wanting published per-user outbound plans with a trial
notIdealFor: Buyers whose primary need is a verified B2B contact mega-database
Enterprise SEP buyers needing coaching/forecasting depth
Orgs that cannot accept LinkedIn automation compliance risk
tradeoffs: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in
Published price transparency vs enterprise custom quoting
Specialization fit vs all-in-one SMB consolidation
recommendation: Choose lemlist when multichannel cold outreach is the job — treat it as SI landscape cold-email coverage, not a ranked contact-database pick. Compare Instantly/Smartlead for cold-email infra; Outreach/Salesloft for enterprise SEP; Apollo/Hunter when data+light outreach is primary.
editorialNotes: SI Priority-4 onboarding 2026-08-17. Approved on sales-intelligence-editorial v1.0.0. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Includes a lead database, but lemlist’s center of gravity is multichannel outbound — not a ranked SI contact-DB peer.
Account-based prospecting and lead finder support outbound; weaker than dedicated SI databases.
Pay-per-success enrichment credits help, but depth trails Clay/Clearbit-class enrichment platforms.
Email + multichannel sequences with deliverability hub are a category strength.
Native CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive) are first-party documented.
Published Email/Multichannel ladder and trial path are approachable for SMB outbound teams.
Campaign reporting supports outbound coaching; not enterprise SI/ABM analytics.
Yearly Email-from-$55 is clear; Multichannel and credits raise TCO — still more transparent than opaque SEP quotes.

overallScoreRationale: Equal-weight average of 8 sales-intelligence editorial criteria, rounded to 1 decimal. Not a hands-on lab score.
